commands.name: init
commands.usage: init [--adopt] [--name n] [--base b] [--bundle dir] [--run level=command]… [--overwrite path]…
commands.does: ask questions, write the profile, render templates, vendor the CLI

commands.name: upgrade
commands.does: re-vendor the CLI from the installed plugin's release

commands.name: index
commands.does: regenerate every index.md in the bundle

commands.name: check
commands.does: OKF validation, plan lint, profile lint

commands.name: status
commands.does: print the state table

commands.name: next
commands.does: print the single next action

commands.name: lane
commands.does: print the computed lane and why

commands.name: card
commands.does: render the unit card

commands.name: start
commands.does: name the worktree branch unit/U-<n> and check its base

commands.name: approve
commands.does: stamp approval (owner only)

commands.name: delegate
commands.does: let the lead approve re-approvals or quick-lane units (owner only)

commands.name: mode
commands.does: record the owner's run mode: unattended or not, the next action to stop at, where to report (owner only)

commands.name: research
commands.does: print the researcher's brief for a question held on the doc

commands.name: retro
commands.does: list what fired, escalated and needed the owner; propose at most three changes; reset the counters

commands.name: review
commands.does: store a reviewer verdict keyed by diff hash

commands.name: report
commands.does: store the builder's report (JSON on stdin)

commands.name: hold
commands.does: record or release an owner hold in the plan

commands.name: priority
commands.does: record an owner priority in the plan

commands.name: fix
commands.does: create a one-unit plan without an intent

commands.name: sync
commands.does: project intents and units onto GitHub issues and a Project

commands.name: push
commands.does: push the base after checking its new commits

commands.name: merge
commands.does: run the merge gate, then merge --no-ff with trailers

commands.name: deploy
commands.does: run the profile's deploy check on the base and record it

commands.name: release
commands.does: run deploy.run and the profile's release on the base, then deploy.smoke, and record them (the owner's)

commands.name: rollback
commands.does: run deploy.rollback and record it (the owner's)

commands.name: hook
commands.does: entry point for hooks; reads the hook JSON on stdin

OKF-FM.fix: give the file a terminated --- block of YAML key: value pairs

OKF-TYPE.fix: add a non-empty type: to the frontmatter

HOUSE-DESC.fix: add title: and a one-sentence description:

HOUSE-LINK.fix: point the link at an existing file or remove it

HOUSE-SIZE.fix: split the doc or move detail into linked docs

PROFILE-RULE.fix: set docs.rules entries to a HOUSE-* code and one of error, warning, off

PLAN-DAG.fix: remove the cycle or point depends at an existing unit

PLAN-AC.fix: give each AC in the unit its own AC-<k>

PLAN-LEVEL.fix: write - AC-<k> (<level>): with a level from profile.levels

PLAN-RESERVE.fix: use <kind> <area>/<n> with a kind from profile.reserve and a number no other unit holds

PLAN-SCOPE.fix: give the unit a scope, narrow the scopes, or add a depends between the units

PLAN-SHARED.fix: drop it from the scope: merge regenerates indexes and the log and runs profile.regen for shared files

PLAN-REQ.fix: cite the requirements the intent or unit serves: requirements: [R-<n>]

PLAN-BOARD.fix: add the planned value to the unit's frontmatter, as the example shows

PLAN-TEST.fix: add a scope glob where the level's tests live, give the AC a level whose paths the scope holds, or add /.aidlc/profile.json to the scope so the unit adds its test location to levels

PLAN-MODULE.fix: name a module from profile.modules, or add the module to the profile

PLAN-DEPENDS.fix: add the other unit to depends, or move the AC to that unit

PLAN-RUN.fix: add levels.<level>.run to .aidlc/profile.json, at least for unit and e2e

PLAN-RUNBOOK.fix: link a Runbook doc from the intent (template .aidlc/templates/docs/runbook.md: how to roll back, what to watch, who to call)

PLAN-SLICE.fix: add an AC at the top level to one of the intent's units (or slice: "<why no end-to-end AC>" on the intent), and test a unit that crosses modules at the integration level or higher

PLAN-GENERATED.fix: add the missing globs to the scope (the profile's generated entry pairs outputs with sources), or scope the tracked file instead of the untracked one

PLAN-DECISION.fix: link a Decision doc from the unit (template .aidlc/templates/docs/decision.md: options, choice, why), for the owner to approve with it, or set twoWay: "<why it is easy to undo>" in its frontmatter

GATE-APPROVAL.fix: the owner approves the unit: they type approve <unit>

SCOPE-OUT.fix: move the change into scope, or the lead widens the scope and the owner re-approves

GATE-LANE.fix: the lead raises the unit's lane, re-renders the card and restarts the review

GATE-AC.fix: add a test tagged with the AC

GATE-LEVEL.fix: move the test under the level's paths in profile.levels

GATE-CHECK.fix: fix the module until its check passes

GATE-PROOF.fix: make each tagged test fail without the change, then report again

GATE-SKIP.fix: run the level where its tests can run (set what it needs), or make the skipped test run; a skipped test proves nothing

GATE-RUN.fix: the builder fixes the code or tests until the level's run passes on the base merged in

GATE-REVIEW.fix: run the reviewer on the current diff and card: aidlc review record

GATE-CARD.fix: render the card (aidlc card) and review against it

GATE-SPECIALIST.fix: run the reviewer with that focus on the current diff

GATE-OKF.fix: fix the doc, then run aidlc check

GATE-SECURITY.fix: fix what the security check reports

ARCH-BOUNDARY.fix: remove the dependency, or the owner approves an exception decision

ARCH-CHECK.fix: fix what the architecture check reports

GATE-SHARED.fix: revert the change; merge writes indexes, logs and shared files

GATE-CONFLICT.fix: merge the base into the unit branch, resolve, and report again

CI-MERGE.fix: merge units only with aidlc merge

CI-COMMIT.fix: commit code only through units; direct commits may touch only docs and workflow files

PUSH-COMMIT.fix: move the change into a unit; direct commits may touch only docs and workflow files

GUARD-FORCE.fix: push without force; history on shared branches is never rewritten

GUARD-PUSH.fix: push the base with aidlc push

GUARD-BASE-DELETE.fix: the base branch is never deleted

GUARD-NOVERIFY.fix: commit with hooks; fix what they report

GUARD-BASE-COMMIT.fix: commit code only in a unit worktree; on the base commit only docs

GUARD-OWNER.fix: allow the prompt to run it, deny to refuse; in a terminal the owner can also type it with !

GUARD-RELEASE.fix: the owner confirms tags and releases

SCOPE-OUT.fix: stop and report; the lead widens the scope

SCOPE-SHARED.fix: leave indexes, logs and shared files to aidlc merge

GUARD-SCHEDULE.fix: only the owner approves: they type approve <doc>

SCOPE-APPROVAL.fix: only the owner approves: they type approve <doc>

SECRET.fix: keep secrets out of the repo; read them from the environment

MODEL-UNIT.fix: name the unit U-<n> in the prompt and start it from its card

MODEL-MISMATCH.fix: pass the model the card names (aidlc card)

queries.project: query($login: String!, $number: Int!, $cursor: String) { {{owner}}(login: $login) { projectV2(number: $number) { id fields(first: 50) { nodes { ... on ProjectV2FieldCommon { id name dataType } ... on ProjectV2SingleSelectField { options { id name } } } } items(first: 100, after: $cursor) { pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { id content { ... on Issue { number repository { nameWithOwner } } } fieldValues(first: 30) { nodes { ... on ProjectV2ItemFieldSingleSelectValue { name field { ... on ProjectV2FieldCommon { name } } } ... on ProjectV2ItemFieldNumberValue { number field { ... on ProjectV2FieldCommon { name } } } ... on ProjectV2ItemFieldDateValue { date field { ... on ProjectV2FieldCommon { name } } } ... on ProjectV2ItemFieldTextValue { text field { ... on ProjectV2FieldCommon { name } } } } } } } } } }
queries.issueCount: query($owner: String!, $name: String!) { repository(owner: $owner, name: $name) { issues { totalCount } } }
queries.addItem: mutation($project: ID!, $content: ID!) { addProjectV2ItemById(input: { projectId: $project, contentId: $content }) { item { id } } }
queries.setField: mutation($project: ID!, $item: ID!, $field: ID!, $value: ProjectV2FieldValue!) { updateProjectV2ItemFieldValue(input: { projectId: $project, itemId: $item, fieldId: $field, value: $value }) { projectV2Item { id } } }
